name: Custom Menu Mod
description: Adds a custom greeting popup, top banner label, and interactive menu button to Geometry Dash!

welcome-message.name: Welcome Popup Message
welcome-message.description: The text displayed in the startup popup.

show-popup.name: Show Startup Popup
show-popup.description: Toggle whether the greeting popup appears on launch.

banner-text.name: Menu Banner Text
banner-text.description: Text displayed at the top of the main menu.
